caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a person standing upright. The figure wears a headdress composed of green, yellow, and red feathers with a golden band at the base. The hair is dark and extends behind the head. Over the shoulders and back, a red draped fabric covers most of the body, exposing the front. The figure is adorned with a necklace of large gold beads and a medallion. The upper garment is gold, crossing diagonally with a green sash and waistband. The skirt is green with gold trim and is decorated with vertical leaf-like patterns. The sleeves and pant legs are gold, with the pants extending down to the ankles, where the feet and lower legs appear roughly carved and unfinished or damaged, revealing a wood texture. The right hand is holding a cluster of small spheres, possibly representing a pinecone. The background is plain and light-colored, and the overall composition centers the figure with no additional objects or scenery. The name "EMIL M. HAGER" appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Cigar Store Indian
